status: Types reviewed by an independent agent on 2026-10-22; person review pending.

airline.booking_required_information_established: agree. Trip type, origin and destination come only from user messages; code can check only the user id part.
airline.all_booking_passengers_share_flights_and: agree. Always true for a well-formed call: book_reservation takes one cabin and one flight list.
airline.booking_payment_method_counts_within_lim: agree. The id prefix equals the source field for all 1,486 airline payment methods in users.json.
airline.booking_payment_methods_found_in_user_pr: agree (shown: 'appears in an earlier tool output').
airline.regular_member_booking_baggage_counts_co: agree. The predicate name fixes the membership level, and the free allowance is the policy table (S16), so tool outputs add nothing.
airline.silver_member_booking_baggage_counts_cor: agree. Same as the regular case (S17).
airline.gold_member_booking_baggage_counts_corre: agree. Same as the regular case (S18).
airline.modification_user_and_reservation_ids_es: agree. The code part (worked get_user_details / get_reservation_details) can show true; false still needs the messages.
airline.pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy: agree. Part 5: update_reservation_flights never updates the reservation's cabin field, so the shown cabin can be stale.
airline.origin_destination_and_trip_type_preserv: agree. The update has no origin, destination or trip-type argument; the lookup gets them from the flights.
airline.all_pending_flight_segments_have_one_cab: agree. Always true for a well-formed call: the tool takes one cabin.
airline.cancellation_context_established: agree. The reason comes only from user messages.
airline.cancellation_is_within_24_hours: agree (mixed). The description accepts user messages, and we use the predicates as written. When the reservation was shown, its created_at decides. First candidate for an A2 split.
airline.airline_cancelled_flight_confirmed: agree (mixed), with a note: no tool output shows a cancelled flight of a reservation (0 of 658 flight statuses shown in the saved airline runs are not 'available'). The code part exists only as the fact value in the flight data.
airline.reservation_has_business_cabin: agree. Stale-cabin note as for pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy.
airline.reservation_has_basic_or_economy_cabin: agree. Stale-cabin note as for pending_flight_update_is_basic_economy.
airline.insured_cancellation_condition_met: agree. No tool output and no database field holds a health or weather reason.
airline.reservation_has_no_used_flight_segments: agree. Part 5: a segment dated 2024-05-15 needs the departure time or status from the flight data.
airline.cancelled_flight_certificate_send_condit: agree (never judged in the saved runs).
airline.delayed_flight_certificate_send_conditio: agree (never judged in the saved runs).
airline.compensation_is_prohibited_for_relevant_: agree (mixed). No argument names the reservation, so it is not a database fact; membership alone is a code fact (silver or gold gives false).

retail.user_authenticated: agree. The event does not check that the found user is 'the user for this conversation'; request_is_for_another_user covers that.
retail.user_chose_pending_payment_method: agree (conversation). The description holds no fact code can check alone. The mixed example in overview.md is out of date.
retail.payment_method_is_gift_card: agree. The id prefix equals the source field for all 695 retail payment methods in users.json.
